mathematical_meanings: Left image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right arrow of the axis passing through the hyperbola center). Right image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right arrow of the horizontal axis beside the two branches).
Rationales: In both images, x names the horizontal coordinate axis. The relevant locations are the right arrow of the axis passing through the hyperbola center on the left and the right arrow of the horizontal axis beside the two branches on the right.
